blurb: Guests can book fishing charters for crappie, striper, offshore, bottom saltwater, and bow fishing on various lakes and the Atlantic coast. Hunting services include guided turkey and alligator hunts with equipment provided. All trips include necessary tackle, bait, and safety equipment; guests must bring appropriate SC licenses and personal items.
extraNote: No lodging included for turkey hunting; accommodations available nearby · $10 per inch charge for alligators over 11 feet
